And you need to ask in the right way, at the right time.
I have been collecting testimonials and using them on my Substack publication, my website, and across my offers, such as my course and cohort for the past six months.
If you wait too long, people forget their experience.
In my experience, people will praise your work, but they will not give strong testimonials unless you ask.
Real testimonials show transformation, clarity, or results. They show concrete results. They need to demonstrate whether what you shared or sold actually worked.
The excitement fades, and the testimonial becomes weak.
